qualityPrompt:
Image quality and natural texture preservation:
Avoid the characteristic AI-generated overprocessed look. Maintain natural visual complexity, balanced detail distribution, and clean, coherent textures throughout the image.
- Avoid excessive microcontrast, oversharpening, artificial HDR effects, and exaggerated local contrast.
- Prevent high-frequency texture noise, repetitive microdetails, artificial grain, and unnatural surface patterns.
- Do not introduce unnecessary tiny details into skin, hair, clothing, backgrounds, or environmental surfaces.
- Preserve smooth, naturally occurring gradients and clean areas without filling every surface with artificial texture.
- Maintain realistic or stylistically appropriate material properties, lighting, reflections, and color transitions.
- Avoid oversaturation, excessive clarity, glowing edges, crunchy textures, and artificially enhanced highlights.
- Preserve fine details where they naturally belong, without applying uniform sharpness or texture density across the entire image.
- Maintain a natural hierarchy of visual detail: important subjects should remain clearly defined, while secondary elements should have appropriate levels of detail.
- Avoid accumulating artifacts, contrast, sharpening, or texture from previous image generations or editing iterations.
- When editing an existing image, preserve its original visual characteristics without amplifying existing noise or introducing additional artificial details.
The final image should look naturally rendered or photographed in its intended artistic style, with clean textures, controlled detail, balanced contrast, and no visible AI-processing artifacts.
